description: Check whether a bridged transfer (any token) has been delivered on the destination chain, by its Hyperlane message id (returned by `bridge`). `direction` must match the original transfer. Returns delivered true/false and the destination-chain delivery tx once relayed. No wallet needed.

direction.description: the direction of the original transfer

messageId.description: the Hyperlane message id from bridge (0x… 64 hex chars)

name: bridge_status
title: Bridge delivery status
